name: DeepSWE
note: v3 remake of the posted DeepSWE episode with the HyperFrames renderer, for comparison. Same facts as episodes/2607.07946 (facts.json), new script and visuals. Scratch folder: it reuses the live item id, so register it only in a copied database.

lines.say: Top agent setups now pass seventy four percent of Deep S W E.
lines.text: Top agent setups now pass 74% of DeepSWE.

lines.say: Every task was written from scratch, and the fixes were never merged upstream.
lines.text: Every task was written from scratch, and the fixes were never merged upstream.

lines.say: Most public coding benchmarks reuse merged GitHub fixes, so a high score can reflect recall, not problem solving.
lines.text: Most public coding benchmarks reuse merged GitHub fixes, so a high score can reflect recall, not problem solving.

lines.say: And their tests were written for one particular fix, so a different fix that works can still fail.
lines.text: And their tests were written for one particular fix, so a different fix that works can still fail.

lines.say: Deep S W E has a hundred and thirteen new tasks, in real open source repos, across five languages.
lines.text: DeepSWE has 113 new tasks, in real open-source repos, across five languages.

lines.say: Each agent gets a short prompt, a repo pinned at one commit with no git history, and one bash tool.
lines.text: Each agent gets a short prompt, a repo pinned at one commit with no git history, and one bash tool.

lines.say: Grading checks behavior, not the diff. Any working solution passes, and regression checks catch breakage.
lines.text: Grading checks behavior, not the diff. Any working solution passes, and regression checks catch breakage.

lines.say: Does that grading hold up? An L L M judge re-checked graded runs.
lines.text: Does that grading hold up? An LLM judge re-checked graded runs.

lines.say: It disagreed with S W E Bench Pro's grader on thirty two point four percent of runs, and Deep S W E's on one point four.
lines.text: It disagreed with SWE-Bench Pro's grader on 32.4% of runs, and DeepSWE's on 1.4%.

lines.say: On the live board, three agent setups now tie at seventy four percent, at very different costs per task.
lines.text: On the live board, three agent setups now tie at 74%, at very different costs per task.

lines.say: With a clear prompt, top agents finish most of these long, multi file changes. Not measured: code quality, partial credit, vague requests.
lines.text: With a clear prompt, top agents finish most of these long, multi-file changes. Not measured: code quality, partial credit, vague requests.
